summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle — data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring at scale — unlike a simple model API where you just call a hosted model via HTTP. You need a platform when you are building, fine-tuning, or retraining custom models, require reproducibility and governance, or must deploy and monitor models in production; a plain model API suffices when you only consume a pre-trained foundation model (e.g. GPT or Gemini) with light prompting or retrieval. In 2026 the lines have blurred: cloud-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex/Gemini Enterprise, Azure ML) compete with the Databricks data-intelligence platform and a growing set of specialized MLOps and compute tools.

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/instance-hour, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fee
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already standardized on AWS needing a modular, AWS-native ML workshop with deep service integration

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/instance-hour plus storage; no platform surcharge
platforms.best_for: Microsoft/Azure-centric enterprises wanting governance, responsible AI, and Azure OpenAI integration

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
capabilities: Mosaic AI for custom foundation models
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs on top of underlying cloud compute; commit/enterprise tiers available
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting a unified multi-cloud data + AI lakehouse platform with strong governance

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini Enterprise)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, training node-hours, prediction, and model usage
platforms.best_for: GCP-based teams and those wanting tight Gemini foundation-model integration (now part of Gemini Enterprise as of 2026)

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; managed version billed via Databricks
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open-source, framework-agnostic experiment tracking and model registry layer

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage subscription for teams and enterprise
platforms.best_for: ML and LLM research teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises seeking automated ML and governed deployment with low data-science headcount

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; pay only for underlying Kubernetes infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Platform teams wanting a self-hosted, Kubernetes-native ML stack with full control

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting automated ML with strong explainability and open-source flexibility

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based, per-second GPU/CPU billing; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting instant serverless GPU compute for training and inference without infra management

platforms.name: Metaflow
platforms.pricing: Free open source; managed via Outerbounds subscription
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting Python-first, human-centric ML pipeline orchestration
